senses.gloss: (b. h.) to wrap up; to cover one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:7:1">Cant. R. to I, 7</cite> <he>וע׳ את בגדו וכ׳</he> and rolled up his cloak and went off.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כאבל הזה שהוא עוֹטֶה על שפמו וכ׳</he> like the mourner that wraps himself up to his lip and weeps.
<cite ref="Nedarim 49b:12">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ברוך שעָטַנִי מעיל</he> blessed be he who wrapped me in a cloak; a. e.
